criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: a scratch-repository test builds pre-C0 history that passes the old history rules (bootstrap commit, a job landed the old way with trailers, then the cutover job as C0). It then builds ONE job branch holding an intervention commit (commit_with_staged), a records-only commit (Committer) and the job landing commit, and lands it via land_pr with a squash merge. The squash commit and each of the three PR commits (via the landing record's second parent) have no 'Athena-' line.
criteria.evidence: The test passes: gh::tests::records_flow::post_c0_job_branch_writes_no_athena_trailers ... ok. It checks that the squash commit and the three PR commits, reached through the landing record's second parent, have no Athena- line. But it builds its history with cutover_fixture::repo(true), which is repo_with(true, None), so the pre-C0 commits are 'init', 'old way' and 'cutover', all labelled 'Athena-Job: bootstrap'. No job is landed the old way with trailers, which the criterion requires. The job landing commit is built by hand with crate::land::fixtures::commit and the message from for_parent, not by Committer::build_commit_in; the test's comment says the gate refuses those records. No hooks are installed, although the planned demonstration said they would be.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: in that repository the landing record classifies the three commits as declared_intervention, records_only and job_landing, and the test asserts check_history and check_attribution return an empty violations list on the post-C0 base. It makes no assertion that violations exist.
criteria.evidence: The test asserts the kinds equal [DeclaredIntervention, RecordsOnly, JobLanding]. It asserts that check_history violations and check_attribution findings are empty three times: on the pre-cutover base, on the post-C0 base, and after the squash. It asserts no violations exist anywhere. The test passed.

findings.summary: The end-to-end test has no job landed the old way, and its landing commit skips the real writer
findings.evidence: repo(true) calls repo_with(true, None), so the 'old way' commit is labelled 'Athena-Job: bootstrap', not a job. The landing commit comes from crate::land::fixtures::commit plus for_parent; the comment says the gate refuses those records, so build_commit_in is not used. No hooks are installed, although the planned demonstration said they would be. Criterion 1 explicitly requires 'a job landed the old way with trailers'.

findings.summary: The new post-C0 branch of retry_landing has no test
findings.evidence: After C0, retry_landing now skips the trailer search and the 'closing commit not found' bail, and no longer writes Athena-Verified-Content. The diff adds no test for this, and docs/decisions.md says: 'retry_landing has no test of its own for the post-C0 branch.' The planned criterion 5 demonstration ('run.rs test resumes a blocked post-C0 job via retry_landing') is missing, against the 'tested' default (a test per reader and writer).

findings.summary: Changed files outside the expected deliverables list
findings.evidence: Neither file is on the expected deliverables list. run.rs was in the planned files. Listed files lifecycle.rs, athena-cli/src/main.rs and land.rs did not change; the end-to-end test is in gh.rs, not lifecycle.rs.

findings.summary: The relaxed squash text and the post-C0 message strip drop any line starting with 'Athena-', not only trailer lines
findings.evidence: Both filter every line with starts_with("Athena-"), including body text. This is harmless in practice and is documented.

summary: Most of the change is sound and well tested. Writers drop Athena- lines after C0 and keep them in every pre-C0 case. squash_text has a strict and a relaxed form. After C0 the gate drops only invariant::check. trace and the auditor fall back to the commits from C0 to head, each with a test that passes. The docs match the code. Two problems fail it. First, the end-to-end test for criterion 1 never lands a job the old way: its fixture's pre-C0 commits are all labelled 'Athena-Job: bootstrap'. Its job landing commit is also put together by hand with for_parent plus a fixture, not built by the real build_commit_in writer, and no hooks are installed. Second, the new post-C0 branch of retry_landing in run.rs has no test, which the docs admit. That breaks the 'tested' default for a reader and writer, and the planned run.rs demonstration is missing. Two changed files are also outside the expected deliverables list: crates/athena-cli/tests/auditor.rs and crates/athena-core/src/run.rs.
